protocol.predicate: Only typed stage guides with complete actual and nominal intended role compatibility. For every strict binary topology-supported alternative rule other than each record intended rule, compute actual any-orientation compatibility and nominal single-guide substitution for each source slot with same actual partner. For catalog-leaf slots only, new rule means any actual orientation and no nominal orientation. A clean flag requires intended and alternative complete mapped endpoint domains disjoint in EVERY applicable actual orientation. Identical singleton in every applicable orientation is unflagged. Mixed/overlapping complete domains are ambiguous, not a proven absence of off-site embeddings or selectivity; they are unknown/ineligible for a clean negative. Cap/error/unresolved is also unknown. A separate complete disjoint alternative remains a positive flag even if another alternative is unknown. No atom-origin, competition, selectivity, or causal claim.
protocol.provenance_rule: For every fixed graph step, require the exact full ancestor graph state in a saved stage return, exact Rules.apply rule/reactants/product, and exact selected leaf ID+SMILES from that stage nearest return (or matching recorded replaced intermediate). Preserve all contributors; divergent guide, quality or source kind is unknown.
